description.en:
A roadside selling stand you can place on your own farm.
It accepts field crops and windrows (grass, hay, straw, alfalfa, clover, flax, hemp, legume straw; including ones added by your map and other mods), bales, wood chips and rope pallets. Nothing else: no milk, other products, fuel or inputs. Tip crops, windrows and wood chips into the pit and drop bales and rope pallets in the bale zone. Both are on the same lane.
Price: 100,000 Pays 100% of the base price. Flooding it with one crop lowers the price, which recovers over 48 in-game hours.
